parameters.query:
WITH record_source AS (
  -- Check expense_tracker_pending (UUID primary key)
  SELECT 
    etp.id::text as id,
    etp.chat_id::text as chat_id,
    etp.date::text as date,
    etp.time::text as time,
    etp.vendor,
    etp.amount::text as amount,
    etp.currency,
    etp.category,
    etp.location,
    etp.payment_method,
    etp.comment,
    etp.parsed_by,
    etp.parsing_time::text as parsing_time,
    etp.provider_tier,
    etp.confidence_score::text as confidence_score,
    etp.receipt_image_url,
    etp.drive_file_id,
    etp.needs_review::text as needs_review,
    etp.review_fields,
    etp.current_fix_index::text as current_fix_index,
    etp.conversation_state,
    NULL::text as amount_sgd,
    NULL::text as exchange_rate,
    etp.submission_datetime::text as submitted_at,
    'pending' as source_table,
    u.telegram_bot_token as bot_token,
    u.id::text as user_id
  FROM expense_tracker_pending etp
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.telegram_chat_id::text = etp.chat_id::text
  WHERE etp.id::text = $1
    AND etp.chat_id::text = $2
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Check expenses table (SERIAL primary key)
  SELECT 
    e.id::text as id,
    e.chat_id::text as chat_id,
    e.expense_date::text as date,
    e.expense_time::text as time,
    e.vendor,
    e.amount_original::text as amount,
    e.currency,
    e.category,
    e.location,
    e.payment_method,
    e.comment,
    e.parsed_by,
    e.parsing_time::text as parsing_time,
    e.provider_tier,
    e.confidence_score::text as confidence_score,
    e.receipt_image_url,
    e.drive_file_id,
    e.needs_review::text as needs_review,
    e.review_fields,
    e.current_fix_index::text as current_fix_index,
    e.conversation_state,
    e.amount_sgd::text as amount_sgd,
    e.exchange_rate::text as exchange_rate,
    e.submitted_at::text as submitted_at,
    'expenses' as source_table,
    u.telegram_bot_token as bot_token,
    u.id::text as user_id
  FROM expenses e
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.telegram_chat_id::text = e.chat_id::text
  WHERE e.id::text = $1
    AND e.chat_id::text = $2
)
-- Always return a row with all fields including source_table
SELECT 
  COALESCE(id, 'NOT_FOUND') as id,
  COALESCE(chat_id, $2) as chat_id,
  date,
  time,
  vendor,
  amount,
  currency,
  category,
  location,
  payment_method,
  comment,
  parsed_by,
  parsing_time,
  provider_tier,
  confidence_score,
  receipt_image_url,
  drive_file_id,
  needs_review,
  review_fields,
  current_fix_index,
  conversation_state,
  amount_sgd,
  exchange_rate,
  submitted_at,
  COALESCE(source_table, 'not_found') as source_table,
  bot_token,
  user_id
FROM record_source
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    vt.id as token_id,
    vt.user_id,
    vt.token,
    u.username,
    u.email
FROM verification_tokens vt
JOIN users u ON vt.user_id = u.id
WHERE vt.token = '{{ $json.text.split(" ")[1] }}'
  AND vt.type = 'telegram'
  AND vt.expires_at > NOW()
LIMIT 1;

-- Update verification_tokens and get user_id
WITH token_update AS (
    UPDATE verification_tokens 
    SET 
        telegram_user_id = {{ $json.telegram_user_id }},
        telegram_username = '{{ $json.bot_username }}',
        verified_at = NOW()
    WHERE token = '{{ $json.text.split(" ")[1] }}'
      AND type = 'telegram'
      AND expires_at > NOW()
    RETURNING user_id, telegram_user_id
)
-- Update users table
UPDATE users u
SET 
    telegram_user_id = tu.telegram_user_id,
    telegram_chat_id = {{ $json.chat_id }},
    is_verified = true
FROM token_update tu
WHERE u.id = tu.user_id
RETURNING u.id, u.username, u.telegram_user_id, u.telegram_chat_id;
